name: AS-NeRF
aliases: Adaptive Scaled Neural Radiation Field with Conditional Diffusion
Conditional Diffusion Model for Sparse-View Reconstruction
Conditional Diffusion Model for Sparse-View Reconstruction (AS-NeRF)
definition: A 3D reconstruction method that conditions a diffusion model on a composite feature vector combining global NeRF scene information and local MTL-FeatureNet details to guide image generation, specifically designed to recover details under complex illumination and depth from sparse viewpoints.
summary: AS-NeRF is a 3D reconstruction method that improves sparse-view accuracy by combining multi-task learning, adaptive scale adjustment, and a conditional diffusion model to synthesize unobserved viewpoints.
